description: Country information API: capital, currency, languages, calling code, flag. Facts about a country from its name or ISO code (2 or 3 letters): official name, capital, region, area, languages, currencies, calling code, internet domain, neighbouring countries, flag emoji, coordinates, landlocked and UN membership. Data: mledoze/countries (ODbL). Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: country_info
